question: Which of the following options is NOT one of the meanings of the homonym 'medium'?

options.text: A channel or system of communication or information
The lowest scale in an evaluation
A substance through which something is transmitted
A person who claims to communicate with spirits

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. The lowest scale in an evaluation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"medium"** has multiple meanings depending on the context. Below are its meanings and usage:

 
• **Meaning 1: A channel or system of communication or information.** (संचार का माध्यम)
 
 
• **Example:** Television is a popular medium for spreading awareness about social issues.
 
 

 
• **Meaning 2: A substance through which something is transmitted.** (संचरण का माध्यम)
 
 
• **Example:** Water is a medium for sound to travel underwater.
 
 

 
• **Meaning 3: A person who claims to communicate with spirits.** (माध्यम, जो आत्माओं से संपर्क करता है)
 
 
• **Example:** The medium claimed to receive messages from the spirit world during the séance.
 
 

 
• **Incorrect Meaning: The lowest scale in an evaluation.** This is not a valid meaning of the word "medium." (यह शब्द "मध्यम" के लिए सही अर्थ नहीं है।)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. The lowest scale in an evaluation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A channel or system of communication or information** (संचार या सूचना का माध्यम)
 
 
• **Example:** Social media has become a vital medium for sharing news and updates.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: A substance through which something is transmitted** (संचरण का माध्यम)
 
 
• **Example:** Glass is often used as a medium for light to pass through.
 
 

 
• **Option 4: A person who claims to communicate with spirits** (आत्माओं से संवाद करने का दावा करने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** The medium was invited to the haunted house to investigate paranormal activities.
